say:1:1230108101:1.text: Well, you've come to the right guy.
say:1:1230108101:1.source_cn: 当然，问我海多克你算是找对人了。

say:2:1230108102:1.text: If you're looking for one to eat, I'd recommend grass carp. Its flesh tastes amazing!
say:2:1230108102:1.source_cn: 如果你是买来吃，那我推荐苔鲤，这种鱼的鱼肉非常鲜美！

say:3:1230108103:1.text: If you're looking for aquarium fish, I'd recommend tidalwave fish.
say:3:1230108103:1.source_cn: 要是买观赏鱼，那我推荐你养啸鱼。

say:4:1230108104:1.text: Tidalwave fish is usually very calm, but before a drastic climate change, it will start thrashing around in the aquarium, producing loud noises. So, it can serve as a tsunami alert!
say:4:1230108104:1.source_cn: 这种鱼平时很安静，但是在气候巨变前，会在缸里拼命挣扎，...
